critical_code_review_comments: magazzino.py:430 list_catalog does .sort('name', 1) at Mongo level then re-sorts in Python for noleggio. Not a bug but the initial sort is wasted CPU; consider skipping it when domain=='noleggio'.

magazzino.py:541 update_kit uses $inc:{version:1} — correct for versioning; snapshot stored BEFORE bump also correct. However version drifts on every save even if items unchanged. Consider only bumping/snapshotting when items or composition actually differ, otherwise every idempotent PUT (e.g. from a UI form re-save) inflates version and pollutes kit_versions.

NoleggioCatalogTab counts rows including category-group header rows (3 headers make total tr = 26 instead of 23). Not a bug (headers are visual) but if any external count check uses 'tbody tr' it will be off by +N_categories. Consider giving header rows a distinct data-testid or role='rowgroup'/'presentation' so tests can exclude them cleanly.
